test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 16 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Method to my madness

options.text: Someone who is unpredictable and can cause damage if not kept in check.
To state a fact so that there are no doubts or objections.
Strange or crazy actions that appear meaningless but in the end are done for a good reason.

solution: The correct answer is **'Option 4'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom** "Method to my madness"** means "Strange or crazy actions that appear meaningless but in the end are done for a good reason." • This** phrase is often used **when someone's actions seem illogical or crazy on the surface, but upon further examination, they actually make sense or are part of a well-thought-out plan. Therefore, the** correct answer **is: *'Strange or crazy actions that appear meaningless but in the end are done for a good reason.'* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ ** • Let's look at the meanings of the other options: • **Someone who is unpredictable and can cause damage if not kept in check:** This option describes a person who is volatile or unpredictable. It does not correlate with the meaning of the idiom.(ऐसा व्यक्ति जो अनिश्चित है और जिसे नियंत्रित नहीं किया जाता है, वह क्षति पहुंचा सकता है।) • **To get someone drunk: **This option is not related to the meaning of the idiom.(किसी को नशे में धुत करना।) • **To state a fact so that there are no doubts or objections:** This option means to clarify something to remove any uncertainty or disagreement. It does not match the meaning of the idiom.( ऐसा कोई तथ्य बताना जिससे कोई संदेह या आपत्ति ना हो।) 43:T62a, The correct answer is **'People that are lonely'.**
